crossRefs.note: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king…

people.name: Abishag
people.line: Beautiful Shunammite who served King David

people.name: Bathsheba
people.line: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.

people.name: Shunammites
people.line: People from Shunem; includes Abishag and the Shunammite woman

translations.web: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.
translations.bsb: So Bathsheba went to see the king in his bedroom. Since the king was very old, Abishag the Shunammite was serving him.
translations.kjv: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
translations.asv: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was ministering unto the king.
